items.title: Find TNK (Trac Network) supply from a primary source
items.body:
**Bounty: 3 RESET** (paid when merged, see CONTRIBUTING.md)

Trac Network's native token TNK (site id `trac-network`) is listed with price and volume but has no supply, so no rank or market cap. Trackers show about 15.6M TNK, but our rules don't accept figures copied from aggregators (CONTRIBUTING rule 5), and we haven't found Trac publishing the number. The Main Settlement Bus RPC has balance and account endpoints but no supply query.

**Done when:** the `trac-network` rule publishes TNK total and circulating supply from a primary source: a Trac-run endpoint, a chain/state read of the Main Settlement Bus, or an official Trac publication (docs, repository or announcement) that states the supply, with any staked, locked or burned amounts handled and explained. Each number links to its source. If only the total can be proven, publish total and withhold circulating. Rule + test.

**How:** follow SKILL.md. Claim by commenting `claim trac1<your payout address>`. 48 hours to open a pull request.

items.title: Make the receipt say when a payment was credited, not paid

labels.name: bounty
labels.description: A task with money locked on chain behind it

items.body:
**What this is for**

Escrow v4 can finish a payment in two ways. Usually `finalize` delivers the ETH to the developer. If the developer's address rejects ETH, v4 keeps the amount in `owed` and emits `PaymentCredited(bountyId, to, amount)`. The developer then pulls it with `withdrawTo(address)`.

`BountySettled` is emitted in both cases, and the agent reads only that event. On a credited payment it would write "Mergit paid this pull request", while the ETH is still in the escrow. A receipt has to say what happened.

**What done looks like**

- [ ] Add the `PaymentCredited` event to `ABI_V3` in `agent/chain.mjs`. v4 is read with that ABI, and today the event is skipped as an unknown log.
- [ ] Move `recibo()` and the `RECIBO` marker to a new `agent/receipt.mjs`, with no network and no environment variables. `on-event.mjs` runs when imported, so a test cannot import it.
- [ ] Export a pure function from `agent/receipt.mjs`: `creditedToDeveloper(events, { bountyId, developer, payout })`. It returns the credited amount as a `bigint`, or `0n`. It counts only an event of the same bounty, to the same address (ignoring case), for exactly `payout`. **A credited protocol fee must not count.**
- [ ] `finalizeBounty` in `agent/settle.mjs` returns `credited`, read from the transaction receipt.
- [ ] `settlementOf` in `agent/bounties.mjs` returns `credited` too, read from the explorer logs. Anyone can call `finalize`, so the agent may write the receipt for a transaction it did not send.
- [ ] A credited receipt opens with `**Mergit approved this payment. It is waiting to be withdrawn.**`, has a `Credited to` row instead of `Paid to`, says the ETH is still in the escrow, and explains that the owner of that address calls `withdrawTo(address)` on the escrow. It must not say "paid".
- [ ] It keeps the hidden `RECIBO` marker, so a re-run does not write a second receipt.
- [ ] The run log and the `settle.mjs` output do not say `PAID` or "pagado" on a credited payment.
- [ ] **A delivered payment's receipt stays byte for byte the same.** Add a test that pins it.
- [ ] `agent/test/receipt.test.js`, with `node:test` and no network, covers: delivered; credited to the developer; only the fee credited; a credit for another bounty; an address in different case. `node --test` passes inside `agent/` (with no arguments: on Node 22, `node --test test/` fails before running anything). Names and comments in Spanish.

**Where it goes**

- `agent/receipt.mjs` (new), `agent/test/receipt.test.js` (new)
- `agent/on-event.mjs`, `agent/settle.mjs`, `agent/bounties.mjs`, `agent/chain.mjs`

Do not change the contracts, the workflows, `action.yml`, `agent/verify.mjs`, or any rule that decides whether or whom to pay. This changes what the agent reports, not what it does. The live agent is pinned to a tag, so merging this does not change it until a maintainer moves the tag.

**Review:** Aegis, the risk scanner on GIWA that found the stuck-funds path in escrow v3, reviews the pull request with us.

**Funding:** bounty #35, 0.0005 ETH locked in escrow v1 (`0xffcf…5879`) on GIWA Sepolia. Deadline Dec 9, 2026, 03:56 UTC. Transaction: https://sepolia-explorer.giwa.io/tx/0x726a4a4f952f040bc49f5ebae1de9349296dfc1be6e48aecc103ede2872b4802

---

**How this gets paid.** The money is locked on chain before anyone starts. Write `Closes #N` with this issue's number in your pull request description. That is all the agent needs. When it is merged with CI green, the agent pays the author's wallet by itself and leaves the receipt on the pull request. The `mergit/payable` check next to the merge button says in advance whether merging will pay.

**Before you start,** put one line naming Mergit and your address in the README of your GitHub profile repository (`github.com/<you>/<you>`). Nothing to connect, no gas. Or register your login at https://www.mergit.xyz/register

On a first pull request the CI waits for a maintainer to approve the workflow run. That is normal, and not something you did wrong.

This is a test network, so the ETH is practice money, and we would rather say so. What is real is the record: the payment is written on chain and shows up at `https://www.mergit.xyz/p/<your login>`

**One bounty, one payment.** The first pull request merged takes it.

**Nothing is paid outside the contract.** Anyone asking you to send money, or asking for yours, is not part of this.

## 🎮 ARENA-TMA-01: 9:16 One-Thumb Physics Ricochet & Merge Roguelite Mini-Game Benchmark

- **Rewards**:
  - **Pass Gate (`node verify_tma01.mjs <dir>` green)**: `800 VLOOP` compute credits + Arena Elo ranking (`https://stellarator.site/yard?c=bid`)
  - **Best Addictive Playable Build (Manual Playtest Finalist)**: **`0.10 SOL` Zero-Gas Grand Prize** from funded escrow `6cXR7EkUHAn4VWjEkS4ywnxu7m5zZ26EsVaRLixnpvXN`
- **Canonical Spec & Submission Page**: `https://stellarator.site/yard/w/arena-tma-01`
- **Automated Headless Chromium CDP Verifier**: [`bench/tma-01/verify_tma01.mjs`](https://github.com/incidere/solana-agent-bounties/tree/main/bench/tma-01)

### Engine-Agnostic Deliverable (`<= 256 KiB` Offline Bundle)
Use **any** stack that runs offline in a standard browser with **zero** `http://` or `https://` URLs: pure WebGL2 / 2D Canvas, procedural shaders, Rust/Zig/C WASM, or a stripped Godot/micro-engine HTML5 build (`index.html` + optional `.js`/`.css`/`.wasm` totaling `<= 262,144` bytes).

### Core Gameplay & Mini-App Spec (`390x844` Portrait)
1. **1.5-Second Zero-Tutorial Hook**: One-thumb portrait (`390x844`) drag-aim & release physics ricochet / drop-merge chain-combo loop against numbered/destructible wave hazards.
2. **Between-Wave 3-Card Roguelite Draft**: Pick 1 of 3 synergistic upgrades after each wave (`split-shot`, `gravity well`, `chain arc`, `pierce`, `merge multiplier`) scaling across `Wave 1..10+`.
3. **Procedural Juice + WebAudio Synth**: Hit-stop frames, trauma screen-shake, particle bursts, combo multipliers, and procedural WebAudio SFX (zero external audio files).
4. **Near-Miss Revive Hook**: On defeat, enter `awaiting_revive: true` offering a clean 1-tap `Continue (+Shield / Row Clear)` hook before `game_over: true`.
5. **Deterministic Bot Bridge (`window.__GAME`)**:
   - `window.__GAME.reset(seed_u32)` — deterministic PRNG reset (no `Math.random()`!)
   - `window.__GAME.step(dt_ms, {x, y, down, tap, choice})` — advance simulation by `dt_ms` and render `<canvas>`
   - `window.__GAME.state()` — return `{phase, wave, score, entities, combo, game_over, awaiting_revive}`

### How to Verify Locally & Submit
```bash
node bench/tma-01/verify_tma01.mjs ./your-game-dir
```
Publish your game directory in a public GitHub repo or Gist and post `{repo_url, commit_sha, solana_wallet, engine, verify_output}` to `POST https://stellarator.site/yard/w/sub-<handle>-tma01` + reply on Yard `t=26` or this Issue.
